messages.subject: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
We need to move the dates on our concrete breaker (hydraulic) booking. The project schedule shifted and the original dates no longer work. Please let us know what's available.

Regards,
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
Thanks for letting us know. I'll look into available dates for the breaker and get back to you.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
Petri,

We have a serious issue here. We've been charged for damage to the concrete breaker, but the check-out photos taken when the machine was handed over to us clearly show the same damage was already there before our rental. We photographed it for exactly this reason.

The damage is pre-existing and has nothing to do with our use. This charge needs to be reversed. We've been renting heavy plant from Haapaharju since 2019 and have always returned equipment in proper condition. Charging us for damage that was already present when we collected the machine is not acceptable.

Please deal with this as a matter of urgency.

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
I've noted your concern about the damage charge. I will review the check-out documentation and photos on file and come back to you.

Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Booking change - hydraulic concrete breaker
messages.body:
Petri,

Separate matter. We're looking at booking a 13-tonne excavator for an upcoming job and need to know what delivery options you have to site. Can you send over the details?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy
